Aadesh Sharma --Appellant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand --Respondent
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
Mr. Tumul K Nainwal, learned AGA, for the State 
of Uttarakhand.
3. The instant criminal jail appeal has been 
preferred on behalf of the appellant – Aadesh Sharma, 
on the recommendation of the Superintendent, District 
Jail, Pithoragarh. The appellant, herein, is convict who is 
convicted by the learned Special Judge (NDPS)/Sessions 
Judge, Champawat in Special Sessions Trial No.36 of 
2023, under Sections 363, 366 of IPC, 9 of Prohibition of 
Child Marriage Act and under Sections ¾ of POCSO Act 
read with Section 376 of IPC, with the sentence of ten 
years rigorous imprisonment with a fine of Rs.25,000/-.
4. As per office report, the appeal is well within 
time.
5. Admit.
6. Summon the trial court record.
7. Mr. Shiv Pandey, learned counsel is appointed as 
legal aid counsel to represent the appellant. The Registry 
is directed to supply the paperbook to Mr. Shiv Pandey.
8. List this matter on 10.08.2026, so that the learned
State Counsel may file the objections.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
16.07.2026
Nitesh/
